'''Holotable''' is a downloaded virtual tabletop for ''Star Wars'' CCG. [[Matt Moseley]] held the 2004&ndash;2007 copyright on the program's readme.<ref name="readme">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071123231323/http://www.holotable.com/readme.php Holotable readme], holotable.com (Wayback, 23 November 2007). Copyright 2004&ndash;2007 Matt Moseley.</ref> ''The Ringer'' dates the launch to late 2004.<ref name="ringer">[https://www.theringer.com/2018/5/21/17374528/star-wars-customizable-card-game-player-community The Force Is Strong With This 'Star Wars' Subculture], Ben Lindbergh, ''The Ringer'', 21 May 2018. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20180523173054/https://www.theringer.com/2018/5/21/17374528/star-wars-customizable-card-game-player-community Internet Archive]</ref> Players enforced the rules themselves on a shared table. The companion deck builder was '''Holodeck'''.<ref name="c1ght">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/holotable-playing-star-wars-ccg-online-the-setup/ Holotable - Playing Star Wars CCG Online - The Setup], Category One Games. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220926090936/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/holotable-playing-star-wars-ccg-online-the-setup/ Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pconline">[https://web.archive.org/web/20150203045154/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Holotable-pic-387x270.jpg Holotable-pic], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 3 February 2015)</ref>

TheForce.Net hosted Holotable from January 2007.<ref name="ht2007">[https://web.archive.org/web/20070315203124/http://www.holotable.com/ holotable.com homepage], Wayback 15 March 2007</ref> On 9 April 2007 it posted twelve preconstructed decks for Classic and Saga lists.<ref name="tfn2007">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Preconstructed_Decks_Now_Available_For_Online_Star_Wars_CCG_104875.asp Pre-constructed Decks Now Available For Online Star Wars CCG], TheForce.Net, 9 April 2007. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071030072612/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Preconstructed_Decks_Now_Available_For_Online_Star_Wars_CCG_104875.asp Internet Archive]</ref> Saga used every card. Classic used a limited list. Saga required a Starting Effect to use Defensive Shields.<ref name="tfn2007" /> Those 2007 names are distinct from the later GEMP [[Classic]] family.

The Players Committee listed Holotable on its software page by 13 December 2013.<ref name="pcsoft">[https://web.archive.org/web/20131213094334/http://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/software/ Software], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 13 December 2013)</ref> Version 0.9.9, announced 2 December 2014 and signed Matt, handled the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset|virtual card reset]].<ref name="ht2014">[https://web.archive.org/web/20141217162132/http://www.holotable.com/ holotable.com homepage], Wayback 17 December 2014. News dated 12/2/14.</ref> [[GEMP]] later provided server-adjudicated play. [[Troy Biesterfeld]] created the Star Wars CCG implementation of GEMP.

Holotable was the usual online table during [[Virtual Original]] and [[Virtual Legacy]]. Championship lists from the [[2014 Match Play Championship]] were published as Holotable exports.
